title: Rockstar Games Employees Lock in Union Vote During GTA6 Window
description: Rockstar Games employees have locked in a union vote for next month, taking place over the GTA6 release window to potentially form the UK's largest recognized union.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Employees Lock in Union Vote During GTA6 Release Window

A significant date has officially been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to formally recognise their developer union. According to reports from media outlet Eurogamer, this crucial ballot is scheduled to take place next month, coinciding directly with the anticipated release window of *Grand Theft Auto 6*.

### A Milestone for the UK Gaming Industry

Should the upcoming vote prove successful, the newly recognised body will achieve a major milestone by becoming the largest recognized union across the entirety of the UK video games industry. The timing of this vote, occurring during one of the most commercially critical periods in gaming history surrounding a flagship title like *GTA6*, highlights ongoing discussions regarding labour rights and workplace representation within major AAA development studios.

### Industry Implications

The broader video games sector has increasingly observed discussions surrounding working conditions, studio culture, and employee organisation. As Rockstar Games navigates its monumental release schedule, the outcome of this union vote could serve as a vital precedent for other developers and publishers operating within the region.

## Editor's Take

Scheduling a union vote during the *GTA6* release window places internal labor discussions directly into the spotlight alongside one of gaming's biggest launches. How this develops will be closely watched by the entire industry as a potential turning point for developer representation in the UK.
